about: Back Bar's collection queue. The weekly routine adds 5 novel drinks here every Friday (status 'collected'); they are NOT in the app yet. A release (monthly or quarterly, on request) moves collected drinks into index.html with tools/release_pending.py and sets status 'released'. 'photo' turns true once the drink's ChatGPT image is installed. pending/index.html turns every drink with photo:false into ChatGPT image prompts, three drinks per image. Status 'reshoot' marks a drink already in the app whose photo is being replaced (install with add_user.py --replace, then set photo:true); the release script ignores it.

drinks.name: Branca Smash
drinks.look: rocks glass with ice, cloudy deep brown-amber with a light pale froth on top
drinks.scene: a Milan aperitivo bar of dark green marble and brass, warm low evening light

drinks.name: Gentle Breeze
drinks.look: tall Collins glass with ice, bright clear pink-red, a lime wedge
drinks.scene: a white-washed beach cottage porch with sheer curtains lifting in the breeze, soft coastal daylight, a halved grapefruit

drinks.name: Final Ward
drinks.note: Created by bartender Phil Ward at Death & Co in New York in 2007 as a rye-whiskey riff on the Last Word.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale gold with a faint green tinge, clear and glossy, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a dim East Village speakeasy with exposed brick and a frosted transom window, low amber bulb light, a small dish of lemon twists on the bar

drinks.name: Mexican Firing Squad
drinks.note: Said to have originated at a Mexico City cantina in the 1930s, named for its fiery kick of grenadine and Angostura bitters.
drinks.look: rocks glass with ice, bright pink-red and slightly cloudy, a lime wheel
drinks.scene: a sun-bleached Mexico City cantina courtyard with cracked terracotta tile and strings of papel picado overhead, bright afternoon light, a bowl of limes on a wrought-iron table

drinks.name: Japanese Cocktail
drinks.note: An 1860s creation credited to bartender Jerry Thomas, notable for using orgeat syrup instead of plain sugar to sweeten a brandy sour.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of warm amber, faintly cloudy from the orgeat, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a candlelit 1860s American saloon of dark mahogany and brass rail, warm gaslamp glow, a small silver bowl of almonds on the counter

drinks.name: Kentucky Buck
drinks.note: A modern bourbon buck created at San Diego's Polite Provisions by bartender Erick Castro around 2013. Muddle the strawberry in the shaker, add everything but the ginger beer, shake with ice, fine-strain over fresh ice and top with ginger beer.
drinks.look: collins glass with ice, amber-gold with a soft strawberry-pink blush and sparkling, a lemon wheel and a strawberry slice
drinks.scene: a sunlit Kentucky horse-farm porch with white picket fencing and bluegrass pasture blurred beyond, warm late-afternoon light, a small basket of lemons

drinks.name: Satan's Whiskers
drinks.note: A gin cocktail created at London's Savoy Hotel American Bar in 1930, built like a Martini brightened with orange juice and orange liqueur.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of bright orange-amber, clear and glossy, an orange twist
drinks.scene: the art deco American Bar of a grand 1930s London hotel, black-and-gold geometric tile and a polished brass rail catching soft lamplight, a few curled orange peels on a silver tray

drinks.name: Vodka Tonic
drinks.reason: Only photo on a plain grey studio backdrop; needs a warm real-world scene like the rest
drinks.look: tall highball glass with clear ice, crystal-clear and sparkling with tonic, a lime wheel on the rim
drinks.scene: a wooden lakeside dock at a Nordic summer cabin, birch trees and still blue water blurred beyond, warm golden evening light

drinks.name: Rum Punch
drinks.reason: Near-twin of Planter's Punch (same glass, colors, garnish, tropical deck and hibiscus)
drinks.look: hurricane glass with ice, deep ruby-red at the base fading to sunset orange, an orange wheel and a cherry on the rim
drinks.scene: a lantern-lit Caribbean rum shack at night, weathered turquoise-painted planks, stacked rum barrels and warm string lights blurred behind, no flowers and no beach

drinks.name: Patrón & Grapefruit
drinks.reason: Same pink-highball-in-a-bougainvillea-town look as Paloma and Patrósa
drinks.look: highball glass with ice, pale blush-pink and softly cloudy from fresh grapefruit juice, a grapefruit wedge on the rim
drinks.scene: a modern Mexico City rooftop terrace at blue hour, polished concrete ledge and potted agave, city lights glowing softly beyond, no flowers

drinks.name: Grasshopper
drinks.reason: Recipe has no garnish but the photo shows chocolate shavings on top
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale mint-green, smooth and creamy with a silky surface
drinks.scene: an old New Orleans French Quarter bar, dark cypress wood, wrought-iron balcony doors and gaslight glow blurred behind

drinks.name: Nutty Irishman
drinks.reason: Recipe has no garnish but the photo shows a spice dusting on top
drinks.look: rocks glass with ice, smooth creamy café-au-lait color
drinks.scene: a snug in an old Irish pub, dark carved wood paneling, a frosted-glass partition and a warm peat-fire glow blurred behind

drinks.name: Bijou
drinks.note: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled glass. Named for the three jewels its colours suggest: gin's diamond, vermouth's ruby and Chartreuse's emerald; first printed in Harry Johnson's 1900 bartender's manual.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of deep jewel-toned amber-red, clear and glossy, a skewered dark cherry
drinks.scene: a Belle Époque jeweller's salon, velvet display trays and soft gaslight glow blurred behind

drinks.name: Brooklyn
drinks.note: Stir with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. The borough's answer to the Manhattan, first recorded in 1908.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale golden amber, clear and glossy, a skewered dark cherry
drinks.scene: a 1900s Brooklyn brownstone parlour with the Brooklyn Bridge glowing through a tall window at dusk

drinks.name: Jack Rose
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled glass. An apple-brandy sour dating to 1908; David Embury counted it among his six basic cocktails.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of soft rose-pink, clear and glossy, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a New England apple orchard at golden hour, rustic wooden crates of red apples blurred behind

drinks.name: Pegu Club
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. The house drink of the Pegu Club, a British officers' club in Rangoon, Burma, in the 1920s.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale citrus-gold, clear and glossy, a lime wedge on the rim
drinks.scene: a colonial-era Burmese club veranda with teak shutters, rattan chairs and slow ceiling fans, tropical green beyond

drinks.name: Army & Navy
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. A gin sour sweetened with almond orgeat, first printed in David Embury's 1948 book.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale creamy-lemon, softly cloudy and silky, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a wood-panelled officers' club library with brass ship instruments and leather armchairs

drinks.name: Bobby Burns
drinks.note: Stir with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. A Scotch Manhattan with a touch of Bénédictine, named for the poet Robert Burns.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of deep mahogany-amber, clear and glossy, a skewered dark cherry
drinks.scene: a Scottish Highland lodge on Burns Night, tartan throws, a stone hearth and candlelight

drinks.name: Widow's Kiss
drinks.note: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled glass. Created by George Kappeler at New York's Holland House Hotel and printed in his 1895 book.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of rich golden-amber, clear and glossy, two skewered dark cherries
drinks.scene: a candlelit Victorian hotel bar with dark carved wood, a gilt mirror and lace curtains

drinks.name: Twentieth Century
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. Named after the 20th Century Limited express train; first printed in the 1937 Café Royal Cocktail Book.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale straw-gold, clear and glossy, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: an Art Deco 1930s railway dining car with polished chrome, etched glass and a blurred landscape through the window

drinks.name: Chrysanthemum
drinks.note: Stir with ice and fine-strain into a chilled glass. A low-strength aperitif from Hugo Ensslin's 1917 book, later served aboard ocean liners.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale honey-gold, clear and glossy, an orange twist
drinks.scene: a Japanese garden teahouse in autumn, golden chrysanthemums and a paper lantern glowing softly behind

drinks.name: Bitter Giuseppe
drinks.note: Express a lemon peel into the mixing glass, stir with ice and strain over a large cube. Created in 2007 by Stephen Cole at The Violet Hour in Chicago.
drinks.look: rocks glass with one large clear ice cube, deep brown-burgundy, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a Chicago speakeasy with tall velvet wingback chairs, chandeliers and moody candlelight

drinks.name: Trident
drinks.note: Stir with ice and strain into an ice-filled glass. A bone-dry Nordic-Italian twist on the Negroni using aquavit, sherry and Cynar.
drinks.look: rocks glass with clear ice, warm russet-amber, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a Norwegian fjord-side boathouse at twilight, weathered red timber and still dark water beyond

drinks.name: Fog Cutter
drinks.note: Shake all but the sherry with ice, strain over crushed ice and float the sherry on top. A Trader Vic's tiki classic from the 1940s.
drinks.look: collins glass of crushed ice, cloudy golden-orange with a darker sherry layer on top, a bouquet of mint sprigs
drinks.scene: a misty San Francisco waterfront tiki bar at night, bamboo, carved tiki masks and fog drifting past lantern light

drinks.name: Jasmine
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. Created in the 1990s by Paul Harrington in Emeryville, California; it tastes remarkably like grapefruit.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of soft pink-grapefruit blush, clear and glossy, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a 1990s California bistro bar with warm blond wood, jasmine vines climbing a sunlit window

drinks.name: Blinker
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. A rye and grapefruit sour from the 1930s.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of coral-pink, lightly cloudy and silky, a grapefruit twist
drinks.scene: a 1930s roadside diner at dawn with chrome trim, a neon sign and red vinyl stools blurred behind

drinks.name: Cameron's Kick
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. A Scotch and Irish whiskey sour with orgeat, first printed in 1922.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale golden cream with a thin silky foam, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: an old Dublin pub snug with a stained-glass partition and brass fittings, a different room from a fireside lounge

drinks.name: Diamondback
drinks.note: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled glass. From Ted Saucier's 1951 book Bottoms Up.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of bright golden-amber, clear and glossy, a skewered dark cherry
drinks.scene: a desert ranch saloon at sunset, weathered wood bar, cowboy hat and rattlesnake-pattern leather blurred behind

drinks.name: Ramos Gin Fizz
drinks.note: Shake hard with ice, strain, dry-shake to emulsify, then pour slowly with soda into a chilled glass and let it settle for a minute to raise the foam. Created by Henry Ramos in New Orleans in 1888.
drinks.look: collins glass without ice, opaque milky-white with a tall stiff white foam rising above the rim, a quarter orange wheel
drinks.scene: a sunny New Orleans Garden District courtyard with a wrought-iron fountain and magnolias, late-morning light

drinks.name: Caesar
drinks.garnish: Celery-salt rim, celery stalk, pickled bean
drinks.note: Roll with ice between two shakers rather than shaking, then strain into a chilled glass. Created in Calgary in 1969 and Canada's national cocktail.
drinks.look: collins glass with clear ice and a celery-salt rim, rich brick-red, a pickled green bean standing in the glass
drinks.scene: a Canadian Rockies lakeside lodge, pine timber walls, snow-capped peaks and a turquoise lake beyond

drinks.name: Saturn
drinks.note: Blend with crushed ice until smooth and pour into a tall glass. Created in 1967 by J. 'Popo' Galsini, it won that year's International Bartender's Association competition.
drinks.look: tall glass of smooth frozen pale-golden slush, a cherry encircled by a lemon-peel ring like a planet
drinks.scene: a 1960s space-age lounge with an atomic starburst clock, a curved white bar and a night sky full of stars

drinks.name: Hotel Nacional Special
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. Named for Havana's grand Hotel Nacional de Cuba in the 1930s.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale apricot-gold, lightly cloudy and silky, a pineapple wedge on the rim
drinks.scene: the grand terrace of a 1930s Havana hotel, palm trees, a colonnade and the Malecón seawall in late sun

drinks.name: Trident
drinks.note: Stir with ice and strain into an ice-filled glass. A bone-dry Nordic-Italian twist on the Negroni using aquavit, sherry and Cynar.
drinks.reason: Photo is a near-twin of Bitter Giuseppe (same rocks glass, single big cube, lemon twist, red-brown colour)
